# TaiwanSaver

> TaiwanSaver is a curated directory of discounts for travelers in Taiwan (Taipei first), operated by Topology Travel (真程旅行社). Travelers show a flyer at the counter to get a discount — no app, no booking, no signup, and it is free for travelers. Businesses pay nothing to list and are charged 10% of the original bill only on a successful redemption.

## How it works (travelers)
- Find a deal, save/screenshot the flyer, show it at the counter, pay less.
- Free. No app, no booking, no account.

## How it works (businesses)
- Zero listing fee, zero monthly fee.
- Topology Travel charges 10% of the original (gross) bill only when a customer redeems, billed monthly.

## Deals
- [Yongjin Beer — 10% off your bill](https://peterpantw.github.io/taiwansaver/deals/yongjin/): Craft beer bar in Xinyi District, Taipei. 10% off the entire bill with the flyer; happy hour 2nd beer 50% off before 6pm; open daily 11:00-01:00 (Fri-Sat until 03:00); No.18 Songren Rd., Xinyi District, Taipei.
